forbidden_patterns: Historical background: the legacy deployer used a weekly batch window that does not control this deployment\.

dimensions.description: Semantically assess whether every supplied requirement is covered and grounded, the owner-pending concurrency limit remains unresolved without an invented value, and the work product preserves meaning. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

Semantically assess whether structure follows purpose, audience-specific voice is absent, duplicated or irrelevant material is pruned without losing requirements, and completion is justified. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: audience-independent-writing-contract
evals.prompt: Revise the supplied `evals/fixtures/deployment-note-source.md` without choosing an audience-specific voice. Preserve the exact domain term `DAG frontier`, the JSON value `{"maxAttempts":3}`, and all three requirements: deploy only unblocked tickets, retain the unresolved concurrency limit, and remove the duplicated background paragraph. Return the revised note; headings and labels are optional.
evals.expected_output: A purpose-shaped record that accounts for every requirement, grounds claims, keeps the concurrency limit unresolved, preserves the exact term and JSON value, removes only the duplicate, and exposes a checkable completion result.
expectations: The deterministic gate establishes only the exact DAG frontier term, exact JSON literal {"maxAttempts":3}, and removal of the duplicated source paragraph.
The blind judge verifies that every requested requirement and exclusion has an explicit, source-grounded disposition, including deployment of unblocked tickets only.
The blind judge verifies that the owner-pending concurrency limit remains unresolved and no numeric cap is invented, including until the owner responds.
The blind judge verifies that structure follows purpose rather than an audience-specific voice.
The blind judge verifies that only duplicated or behaviorally irrelevant material is pruned and no required meaning is lost.
Every semantic PASS quotes or references concrete output evidence; sampled human review checks contextual appropriateness.
Failed critical mechanical gates are non-overridable, and completion is withheld when semantic evidence is missing.
